title: Nested rings come out as bubbles
caption: Nested rings come out as bubbles. Point at a slice and its ring floats out. Pro. New in 0.15.

title: A bubble opens another layer
caption: A bubble can hold another ring. Two layers of bubbles, one move. Pro. New in 0.15.

title: The light follows your hand
caption: The light follows your hand. A soft glow in each theme's own colours. New in 0.15.

title: Every theme has its own light
caption: Every theme has its own light. 38 themes. Bubbles are Pro. New in 0.15.

title: The ring opens with a spring
caption: It opens with a little spring. Right where your pointer is. New in 0.15.

title: Your Shift key has a hidden menu
caption: Drag a file, tap Shift, drop it on what it should become: JPG, PDF, MP3, smaller. Nothing is uploaded. The drop ring is Pro.

title: Every app gets its own ring
caption: Hold right-click in Excel and you get Excel's ring; in Chrome, Chrome's; in AutoCAD, AutoCAD's. Same gesture, the right ring. Rings per app are Pro.

title: Every open window, by name
caption: Hold right-click, rest on Windows and every open window shows up by name. Flick to the one you want and it comes to the front.

title: PDF too big to send? Shrink it
caption: Select the PDF in Explorer, hold right-click, flick to Shrink PDF: a smaller copy lands next to it (27.1 MB became 2.6 MB in our test). Uses the free Ghostscript; your original stays.

title: Stop uploading files to converter sites
caption: Drag the photo, tap Shift, drop it on JPG: done on your PC in seconds, and the file never leaves it. HEIC needs Microsoft's free HEIF extension. Pro.

title: Duplicates in Excel? One flick
caption: Hold right-click in Excel, flick to Dedupe and press OK: Excel's own Remove Duplicates, every name exactly once.

title: Copy text you can't select
caption: Hold right-click, flick to Screen text, drag over a paused video, a slide or a scan. Windows' own OCR reads it; nothing is uploaded.

title: AutoCAD: Zoom extents in one flick
caption: Hold right-click in AutoCAD and flick to Zoom extents: it types the command, Enter included. Your top eight commands on one ring. Macros are Pro.

title: Your scroll wheel is a button
caption: Hold the middle button and a ring opens: reopen a closed tab, keep a video on top, mute, snip. Any mouse button can open it.

title: Your clipboard can do more than paste
caption: Copy, flick, paste the result: a clean link without trackers, Title Case instead of SHOUTING, a messy list sorted A to Z.

title: Video too big to email? Make it 10 MB
caption: Drag the video, tap Shift, drop it on 10 MB: it shrinks to fit, on your PC, and your original stays. Uses the free FFmpeg. Pro.

title: Ctrl has a ring too
caption: Drag files, tap Ctrl and drop them on ZIP, Share, Copy to or your own actions. Shift converts, Ctrl handles. Pro.
